tools.name: amount_to_words
tools.description: Convert an amount in a currency to words for cheques, invoices and contracts, in 56 languages. Arabic output applies number–noun agreement (درهم واحد / درهمان / ثلاثة دراهم / أحد عشر درهماً) and the correct minor unit (فلس، هللة، قرش…); English uses CLDR currency names. style='cheque' adds the custo

tools.name: number_to_words
tools.description: Cardinal, ordinal or year wording of a number in 56 languages (en, ar, fr, de, es, pt, it, nl, tr, ru, hi, ur, id, ja, ko…). Example: number 2026, language 'en', to 'year' → 'twenty twenty-six'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; determinis

tools.name: format_number
tools.description: Locale-correct display of a decimal, currency amount or percentage using CLDR rules: grouping (1,234,567 / 12,34,567 / 1.234.567 / 1 234 567), decimal mark, currency symbol placement, Arabic-Indic digits for ar_* locales. Example: number 1234567.891, locale 'en_IN', style 'currency', currency 'INR'.

tools.name: parse_number
tools.description: Turn '1.234,56', '١٬٢٣٤٫٥٦', '12 345,6' or '1,234.56' into an exact decimal, using the locale's separators first and a clearly flagged heuristic when they do not match. Example: text '1.234,56', locale 'de'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[

tools.name: convert_digits
tools.description: Rewrite digits between Western (0-9), Arabic-Indic (٠-٩) and Persian/Urdu (۰-۹) anywhere in a text, leaving everything else untouched. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.

tools.name: normalize_arabic
tools.description: Clean Arabic text for matching, search and storage: strip diacritics and tatweel, unify alef forms, optional ة→ه and ى→ي, Western digits, Latin punctuation, whitespace. Reports exactly which rules changed the text. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, wa

tools.name: transliterate
tools.description: Deterministic romanisation of any script to plain ASCII (Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, Devanagari, Thai, Arabic…) for slugs, sorting, matching and systems that reject non-ASCII. Not an official spelling: for Arabic names the result is a consonant skeleton and is flagged low confidence. Response: result plus

tools.name: detect_script
tools.description: Proportions of writing systems in a text (latin, arabic, cyrillic, han…), dominant script, RTL/LTR direction, mixed-script flag, which digit systems appear, and hints such as Persian/Urdu-specific letters. Free. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warni

tools.name: parse_date
tools.description: Turn a date written in natural language or local numeric formats into an ISO date/datetime: '3 mars 2026', '12.11.2026', 'next month', 'غداً', 'in 3 weeks', and Hijri dates such as '15 رمضان 1447' or '1 Muharram 1448' (converted by Umm al-Qura). tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Languages available for words, the curated Arabic-grammar currencies, and notes on locales. Free. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.
